title: Notify waiting clients, reorder the queue or mark a client as left
summary: Use explicit front-desk actions while preserving the queue’s real order.

sections.title: Request a turn notification
sections.body:
Open the waiting client’s details and select **Notify client**. Review **Notify client?**, then confirm **Notify client**. The queue records that the notification was requested.

A request is not proof of delivery. The client’s channel choice, consent and available sending capacity still apply. Check **Client notifications → Delivery history** when delivery matters; use the customer’s permitted contact channel if direct follow-up is needed.

sections.title: Change the waiting order
sections.body:
Only users with both queue-management and schedule-override access can reorder.

1. Open **Reorder queue**.
2. Use the move-up or move-down controls to arrange the complete waiting list.
3. Enter the required **Reason**.
4. Select **Save order** and verify the resulting positions.

Search and filters do not change queue order. Position and **NEXT** refer to the real saved order. Starting a later client does not silently reorder everyone else. If the queue changed during review, refresh and review the new order.

sections.title: Record a departure
sections.body:
For a waiting client who has left, use the departure action, enter **Reason** and confirm **Mark as left**. The client leaves the active queue while their waiting and visit history remains.

Do not mark a client as left to cancel a visit that already exists in Calendar. Use that appointment’s normal cancellation process. Recently finished records can be expanded for follow-up, including authorized Checkout links.
